settings.folder-hint: Generated images are grouped here, so they can be found, audited or purged as a set.
settings.key-hint: Read from the admin first, then config/plugins.ts, then IMAGE_GEN_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY. An existing Gemini key is picked up with no configuration at all.
settings.style-hint: DESCRIBE the look — “photographic, direct flash, hard shadows, muted palette”. Do not write an instruction: the API has no system field, so the style travels inside the prompt, and “write prompts for…” is obeyed as an order — the model answers with text instead of drawing.
settings.style-placeholder: Photographic, natural light, muted palette, no text.
settings.subtitle: Google API key and the defaults editors inherit.
settings.test-ok: The key works — one 1K test image was generated (about $0.034).
